scope: public-model feasibility and execution checks; not a CASMI accuracy experiment

fiora.weight_loader: author load_from_state_dict, torch.load(weights_only=True); no dill object loading
fiora.actual_execution: isolated local sandbox CPU inference with unmodified author source
required_before_integration: timsTOF-domain validation rather than silently asserting HCD equivalence
pretraining overlap audit or an explicit overlapping-data qualification
reproducible supported-mode reranking gain on unspent validation data
official pinned RDKit deployment and offline environment verification

frigid.eligibility: Weight-record license is different from code license; competition use/redistribution permission must be resolved before deployment, not inferred from code openness.
frigid.scientific_dependency: Requires compatible radius-2 4096-bit fingerprint and molecular formula; current radius-3 4096-bit head is not interchangeable.

ms_gpt.qualification: Fetching the sharing-page HTML is not fetching or testing model weights. Formula and fingerprint interface compatibility also require validation.

limitations: FIORA example reproduction establishes an executable baseline, not unknown-molecule identification quality.
No measured gain from formula prediction, generative structure recovery or forward-model reranking is claimed.
No third-party weights were merged into the R07 bundle or its already verified notebook.
